description: This file defines an enumeration 'NetworkInterfaces' with a static method to retrieve the primary IPv4 address of the 'en0' network interface, or fallback to another available address if 'en0' is not found.

methods.name: primaryIPv4Address
methods.description: Returns the primary IPv4 address associated with the 'en0' network interface, or a fallback address if 'en0' is not available.
